camps.name: Challenge Camp
camps.description_short: An enrichment day camp at Iona University in New Rochelle for ages 4 to 15. Campers pick two morning workshops from more than 140 STEM and arts electives, such as coding, robotics, filmmaking and chess, then three afternoon periods of sports, swim or more enrichment; children entering kindergarten have their own program.
camps.notes: 2027 tuition is not posted yet; registration opens January 2027. Full day is 9 to 4 with optional early morning from 8 and extended day to 6, both extra. Door to door buses from Manhattan, Riverdale and southern Westchester, central stops in northern Westchester. Hot lunch and snack included, kosher lunch available. Nut and seed free.

camps.description_short: A coed day camp on a wooded property in White Plains, about a mile from Ardsley, for children from age 3 through grade 8. Campers rotate through swim lessons in three heated pools, sports, arts, an adventure park with zip lines and a climbing wall, woodworking, cooking and science, with programs set by age.

Grades 7 and 8 join EWD Voyagers, a travel program with day trips and overnights that starts and ends each day at the Leffell School, July 5 to August 13, 2027, two week minimum. Three year olds can attend a half day (9 to 12:15) or mini day (9 to 2). The food service is peanut and tree nut free.

camps.name: Hackley Summer Programs
camps.description_short: Two weeks of June programs on the Hackley School campus in Tarrytown for students entering kindergarten through grade 12, taught mostly by Hackley faculty. Families build a schedule from morning, afternoon and full day courses in academic enrichment, arts, STEM, games and sports camps.
camps.refund_policy_summary: A $150 deposit per camper is non refundable. After registration, refunds are given only for a verifiable medical reason; a $50 fee applies to program changes from May 1 and none are made after June 1.

Morning session 9 to 12, afternoon 1 to 4; lunch and a supervised recess are included for children staying both sessions. Early drop off from 8 and late pick up to 5:30 for a fee. Open to students from any school. Steve & Kate's Camp (ages 4 to 12) also runs on the campus in July and August as a separate program.
